name: Intruder on the Bridge
source: Intruder on the Bridge tells the story of Captain Dyce, a Galactic Union officer in command of the largest spaceship ever built: the Ventura. He will have to face a mysterious conspiracy that caused his brother's death. Unfortunately, all leaders of the Union seems to be involved in the conspiracy. Intruder on the Bridge is an adult visual novel that boasts to have six hours of content, with 3000 images and 30+ minutes of full HD videos. In addition to that, you will find some funny mini games (i. e. Shoot'em up and simple FPS). Players will interact with dozen characters, everyone with their own behaviour and background. Player's choices will change the developing of the story, as a warranty of many hours of fun. Are you ready to command the Ventura? And to flirt and seduce your hottest officers with your charm? If so... Don't miss Intruder on the Bridge!
translation:
《Intruder on the Bridge》講述了戴斯艦長的故事。身為銀河聯盟的軍官，他指揮著有史以來建造的最大宇宙飛船——文圖拉號。他將面對一場導致他兄弟身亡的神秘陰謀，而不幸的是，聯盟的所有高層似乎都牽涉其中。

本作是一款成人視覺小說，包含約6小時的內容、3000張圖片，以及超過30分鐘的Full HD影片。此外，還有射擊類、簡易第一人稱射擊等趣味小遊戲。玩家將與十餘名性格、背景各異的角色互動，透過選擇改變故事的發展，享受數小時的遊戲樂趣。

準備好指揮文圖拉號，並用你的魅力與那些火辣的軍官調情、俘獲她們的心了嗎？那就別錯過《Intruder on the Bridge》！
